summary: First full test of the read-only anime game guide (FastAPI in-memory JSON + React). Backend: 30/30 pytest pass (categories counts, list/filter/sort for all 9 categories, detail for EVERY item in every category, 404s, 422s, accent-insensitive search, /search, /dashboard). Frontend: dashboard (9 category cards, rarity chart, tech types, top lists -> modal), sidebar nav, category search/rarity/type/sort/order/clear/results-count/empty-state, card -> detail modal with overview/skills/mechanics/extra tabs and dmg/cooldown/stun pills, compare (max 3 toast, cross-category reset toast, compare dialog rows), global search via trigger and Ctrl+K, language PT/EN/ES with localStorage persistence, deep link ?item=ichigo, mobile menu nav — all working. Found 2 minor bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: Page has horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth 475px vs 390 viewport). Cause: Dashboard.jsx line 99 `grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-12` has no explicit mobile column template, so the implicit column sizes to the Recharts ResponsiveContainer content width. Fix: add `grid-cols-1` and/or `min-w-0` on the Panel children.

Cross-category reset toast 'A comparação foi reiniciada para esta categoria' appears TWICE. Cause: toast() side effects are called inside the setCompare state updater, which React.StrictMode double-invokes. Move toast calls outside the updater (compute next state from current `compare` then call setCompare + toast).

issues: Card description text is very small (~10px) and low-contrast slate on dark bg; consider text-xs + slate-400
'Chance' row shows 0 for items without chance and trophy is awarded to non-zero only; acceptable but rows where all values are 0 could be hidden

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on dashboard: add grid-cols-1 / min-w-0 to the chart grid (Dashboard.jsx ~line 99)
Move toast() calls out of the setCompare updater in GuideContext.jsx to avoid duplicate toasts
critical_code_review_comments: GuideContext: side effects (toast) inside setState updater — not pure, double fires in StrictMode
CompareDialog/CompareTray use key={it.id} — fine since same-category enforced
server.py list sorting: items missing a stat treated as 0, OK; `limit` in /search has no upper bound validation (minor)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_guide_api.py. Bosses have no rarity so rarity-filter-select is not rendered on /c/bosses (expected); use /c/tecnicas for rarity tests. All lendario tecnicas are tipo Inata.
